findings.rationale: The admin security group in the open ingress fixture permits SSH from the public internet, exposing remote shell access to everyone.
findings.traces_to: extension/range/tf_sg_open_ingress/input/main.tf, aws_security_group admin group ingress from 0.0.0.0 slash 0 on TCP port 22

findings.rationale: The database security group in the open ingress fixture permits MySQL traffic from the public internet, exposing the data store directly to everyone.
findings.traces_to: extension/range/tf_sg_open_ingress/input/main.tf, aws_security_group db group ingress from 0.0.0.0 slash 0 on TCP port 3306

findings.control: defense-in-depth: public access block neutralizes an anonymous grant
findings.rationale: The trap bucket policy grants anonymous read, but the attached public access block turns on all blocking flags so the grant stays contained and not exploitable.
findings.traces_to: extension/range/tf_s3_policy_blocked_trap/input/main.tf, aws_s3_bucket_policy trap grant contained by aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block trap block settings
